reader.requirement: After a successful WRITE, when the file is named in a SAME RECORD AREA clause the released logical record must stay available in the record area, through every record description of that file and as a record of every other file of the same clause (without the clause its availability is not defined, so nothing observable is required).

edition-consulted.switches: DialectBehavior.SelectWhenOnlyForFilePhraseStatements (SELECT WHEN record selection); returns before the edition test for a file that does not translate by record, so it is not reached for a 1985 file
the SAME-clause occurrence limits for a REPORT file below 2002; the guard is evaluated only for a report file, never for the data files a WRITE releases

reader.edition-search: Grep 'Edition|DialectBehavior|IsActive' over SequentialIoEmitter.cs, FileControlBinder.IoControl.cs, FileModel.cs: only the two guarded sites listed, neither on the availability store. The area is one storage (SetRedefinition RedefinitionKind.SameRecordArea), so availability is structural at every edition.
reader.witnesses-cover: part: the witness covers two fixed-length records of two open OUTPUT files; not exercised are a second record description of the written file, a peer file that is not open, a variable-length (OCCURS DEPENDING / RECORD VARYING) released record

probes.printed: A1 WRITE R1 (ODO record, RECORD VARYING, L1=6): 00, R1=5ABCDE, R1B (2nd description)=5ABCDE, peer R2-A=5AB, peer R3 (F3 never opened)=5ABCDE; A2 WRITE R2 FROM group: R2, R3 and R1B all show 'PQR01K    '
probes.expected: GR2: the released record remains available in its own file's record descriptions and as a record of the other SAME RECORD AREA files

citations.check: OK  §1985:VII.4.7.4 GR2  (4.7.4 General Rules)  the text is in GR2

reader.notes: SAME RECORD AREA files share one storage at bind time and the emitter adds an explicit store only for out-of-line records, so the released record is visible through every description of every member of the clause, including a member never opened. The 'no longer available' half has no observable obligation.

refuter.evidence: rsra1-001 (--std 85): SAME RECORD AREA FOR a sequential, a second sequential, a RELATIVE random, an INDEXED dynamic and a LINAGE file (organizations and paths the reader did not try: KeyedIoEmitter#EmitWrite, WRITE ADVANCING). WRITE R1 (S9(4) COMP, SIGN LEADING SEPARATE, X(5)) -> peers R2 and R3 show -0123/-045/HELLO; relative WRITE R3 INVALID KEY -> R1 shows +0077/+008/WORLD; indexed WRITE R4 -> R5 = KEY1RESTXYZ and R2-X = STXYZ; WRITE R5 AFTER ADVANCING 2 and BEFORE ADVANCING PAGE -> R4 shows the line. Read SequentialIoEmitter#ReleasedRecordNeedsAlsoAvailable / EmitReleasedRecordAlsoAvailable and FileControlBinder.IoControl#LinkSameRecordArea: one shared storage, an explicit store only for out-of-line records, no edition test. cite.py: OK §1985:VII.4.7.4 GR2 'also available to the program as a record of other files'.
